_comment: Copy to config.json (gitignored) and fill in your own keys, then run with --dart-define-from-file=config.json. Nothing here is secret; config.json is where the real values go and it is never committed.
_GROQ_API_KEY_2_3_4: Optional extra Groq keys. The multi-agent planner spreads its agents across the keys you set (2-3 agents per key) so parallel workers do not hit one key's rate limit. Leave them out to share GROQ_API_KEY.
_TAVILY_API_KEY: Powers the agents' shared web_search / fetch_page tools (hotels and hotspots for any area). Free plan: 1,000 credits a month per key, no card. Extra keys multiply the budget.
_GEOAPIFY_API_KEY: Hotels and attractions with coordinates and wheelchair tags. Free plan: ~3,000 credits a day. Requires a 'Powered by Geoapify' credit.
_XOTELO_RAPIDAPI_KEY: Optional. Only Xotelo's /search endpoint (city -> TripAdvisor location key) needs it, via RapidAPI. Hotel lists, live rates and price heatmaps need no key.
_CENTRAL_REGISTRY_BASE_URL: Where the Central Registry backend (server/) is reachable. Default http://10.0.2.2:3001 is the Android emulator's alias for your dev machine's localhost. On a physical device use your host's LAN IP, e.g. http://192.168.1.23:3001
